shard: Italy and France: every pending row of scripts/data/rosterConfirmation2026.json whose club plays in the Club Manager Serie A or Ligue 1 (51 rows at origin/main 5f2622fd: Italy 32 across Atalanta, Cagliari, Como, Fiorentina, Frosinone, Inter Milan, Lazio, Lecce, Monza, Napoli, Parma, Roma, Sassuolo, Torino, Udinese and Venezia; France 19 across Angers, Brest, Le Havre, Lens, Lille, Lorient, Lyon, Marseille, Monaco, PSG, Strasbourg, Toulouse and Troyes)
method: Each row was read on the web on 2026-10-03 with WebFetch and WebSearch. A row leaves pending only when an official page (family A: the Lega Serie A squad page at legaseriea.it, the Ligue 1 club page at ligue1.com, or a club's own squad page or announcement) and an independent publisher on another host (family B: ESPN squad or player pages, Soccerway, FotMob) agree where the man is. Wikipedia and other wikis are never a source. Birth dates go in the note where a source gives one, so a namesake cannot be mistaken for him; every one of the 51 names appears exactly once in src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts at origin/main 5f2622fd, so no namesake in the game is involved. A season-long loanee is placed at the club he plays for, with loan and loanFrom as information only, the ledger's loanPolicy. The to field is the Club Manager club name the bake knows (checked against the 368 clubs of src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts at origin/main 5f2622fd); realClub is the club as the sources write it. This file is folded into rosterConfirmation2026.json by the lead; nothing reads it directly.
